dedupe_keys.name: spreadsheet tools for a simplified evaluation of liquefaction induced settlement

description: Spreadsheet Tools for a Simplified Evaluation of Liquefaction-Induced Settlement is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Riwaj Dhakal, University of Canterbury (canterbury.ac.nz). This dataset includes the two spreadsheet (.xlsx) tools that can be used for routine engineering evaluation of liquefaction-induced settlement of ground and buildings on shallow foundations using the Cubrinovski-Dhakal method. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 2 top-level files (XLSX). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-j0nj-3270. Keywords: Earthquake, Liquefaction, Settlement, Shallow Foundations, Simplified Analysis, CPT. Published 2025-03-06. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 3-Clause BSD License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
